title: Selfless inclusions arising from commensurator groups of hyperbolic groups
summary: We provide new examples of $\mathrm{C}^*$-selfless groups and inclusions. In particular, we prove that the commensurator group ${\rm Comm}(H)$ of a torsion-free hyperbolic group $H$ is $\mathrm{C}^*$-selfless. Our approach involves showing that the Gromov boundary $\partial H$ is a topologically free extreme boundary for ${\rm Comm}(H)$, ${\rm Aut}(H)$, and for other groups that contain $H$ in an almost normal way.
